intro.headingLine1: The car most of our clients
paragraphs: A solo executive arriving with a briefcase and a carry-on, a couple with two suitcases, a day of meetings across Prague — the E-Class is made for exactly these journeys. It seats up to three passengers and carries two large cases plus two cabin bags in its 540-litre boot.

The cabin is quiet and well appointed: leather seats, dual-zone climate control, Wi-Fi and fast charging. It is the default business sedan of Central Europe, and it does the job without drawing attention.
Every Prestigo E-Class is an E 220 d or E 300 de Hybrid, 2025 model year or newer, black with a leather interior, and prepared before every journey.

items.title: Leather interior
items.body: Comfortable leather seats in a calm, uncluttered cabin — a quiet place to prepare for the day.

items.title: Dual-zone climate control
items.body: Your preferred cabin temperature is set before the car reaches you — noted once, remembered for future bookings.

items.title: Wi-Fi with no data cap
items.body: Enterprise-grade 5G Wi-Fi for emails and calls on the way from the airport to the first meeting.

items.title: Fast charging
items.body: USB-C and USB-A ports within reach, with Apple and Samsung fast charging supported.

items.title: Bottled water
items.body: Chilled still and sparkling water on every journey.

items.title: A professional chauffeur
items.body: Background-checked drivers with professional qualifications and fluent English; Russian, German or Czech on request.

steps.label: How it works
steps.heading: Booking an E-Class in four steps.

items.title: Choose the E-Class
items.body: Enter the pickup, destination and time, then select the E-Class. The fare is fixed before you pay.

items.title: Add your flight
items.body: For an airport pickup, add the flight number — your driver follows the arrival in real time.

items.title: Meet your chauffeur
items.body: You receive the driver’s name and phone number in advance. At the airport they wait inside the Arrivals hall with a name board.

items.title: Arrive on time
items.body: Luggage handled, route planned, and you arrive ready for the day.

editorial.label: Where the E-Class goes
paragraphs: Most E-Class journeys start at Václav Havel Airport. Every transfer includes flight tracking, a name board in the Arrivals hall and up to 60 minutes of free waiting, so a delayed flight costs you nothing extra. Hourly hire keeps the car and chauffeur with you for a day of meetings across the city.

For trips to other cities — Vienna, Munich, Berlin, Dresden and more — fixed-price routes include tolls and vignettes. Companies with regular travel can open a corporate account with monthly invoicing.

faqs.q: How many passengers and how much luggage fit in the E-Class?
faqs.a: The E-Class seats up to 3 passengers and carries 2 large suitcases plus 2 cabin bags in its 540-litre boot. For more passengers or luggage, choose the Mercedes V-Class.

faqs.q: Is the E-Class a good choice for a Prague Airport transfer?
faqs.a: Yes — it is our most popular airport car. Your chauffeur tracks the flight, waits inside the Arrivals hall with a name board and includes up to 60 minutes of free waiting after landing, all for a fixed fare.

faqs.q: What is included in an E-Class booking?
faqs.a: A professional chauffeur, meet and greet with a name board, flight tracking and free waiting at the airport, Wi-Fi, fast charging, still and sparkling water, and child seats on request at no extra charge. Tolls and vignettes are included on intercity routes.

faqs.q: Which E-Class models does Prestigo operate?
faqs.a: Our E-Class cars are the E 220 d or E 300 de Hybrid, 2025 model year or newer, black with leather interiors. They are serviced by authorised Mercedes-Benz technicians on the factory schedule and inspected before every journey.

faqs.q: Can I hire the E-Class with driver by the hour?
faqs.a: Yes. Hourly hire has a 2-hour minimum and keeps the car and chauffeur with you for meetings, shopping or an evening out. Extra time is added at the same rate.

faqs.q: What is the difference between the E-Class and the S-Class?
faqs.a: Both seat 3 passengers with the same luggage capacity. The S-Class adds an executive rear package with more legroom, massage seats, Nappa leather and a quieter cabin — it suits VIP guests and long intercity journeys. For most airport and city trips, the E-Class is the natural choice.

faqs.q: How far in advance should I book?
faqs.a: Book online at least 12 hours ahead. For shorter notice, call +420 725 986 855 — we operate 24/7.
